description: This file defines the class 'nusoap_base', a foundational component of the NuSOAP web services toolkit for PHP. It includes methods for serialization/deserialization of XML data, namespace management, debugging, error handling, and utility functions for working with SOAP messages and XML schema types.

classes.name: nusoap_base
classes.description: A base class providing core SOAP serialization, namespace management, debugging, and utility functions for the NuSOAP PHP toolkit.

methods.name: serialize_val
methods.description: Serializes PHP values into XML according to SOAP and XML schema rules.

methods.name: serializeEnvelope
methods.description: Constructs a complete SOAP envelope message with headers and body.

methods.name: formatDump
methods.description: Formats a string for HTML display (deprecated).

methods.name: contractQname
methods.description: Contracts a QName by replacing namespace URI with prefix.

methods.name: expandQname
methods.description: Expands a QName prefix to its namespace URI.

methods.name: getLocalPart
methods.description: Extracts the local part of a prefixed name.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Extracts the prefix from a prefixed name.

methods.name: getNamespaceFromPrefix
methods.description: Retrieves a namespace URI given a prefix.

methods.name: getPrefixFromNamespace
methods.description: Retrieves a prefix given a namespace URI.

methods.name: getmicrotime
methods.description: Returns current time in ISO format with microseconds.

methods.name: varDump
methods.description: Returns a string representation of variable dump output.
